migration_origin: Curated from V2.1 pose system + Image Library posing collections; prompt prose intentionally not copied.

poses.mechanics: weight balanced or subtly shifted to one leg; shoulders relaxed; hands each have a clear destination
pelvis and torso establish the turn before the head; gaze returns toward camera; avoid impossible neck rotation
one hand lightly contacts a small hair section near temple/ear; fingers remain visible and relaxed
sit near front edge of seat, spine supported by pelvis, legs grouped/angled, at least one hand anchors naturally
one knee raised as structural anchor; one arm may rest on it; second leg/support stays physically readable
one hand controls grip, other controls scabbard/balance; feet establish a recoverable stance; no floating weapon
viewer weight shifted toward display but remains behind barrier; hands do not penetrate glass/object
